collision_audit.notes: ADDRESS COLLISION: Homewood Suites DAYFBHW (IDENTITY_CONFIRMED) and Staybridge Fairborn DAYBF (IDENTITY_PROVISIONAL) both claim 2750 Presidential Dr, Fairborn OH 45324. BRAND CONFLICT: 8099 Old Yankee St, Dayton 45458 — first agent found 'The Hotel at Dayton South' (independent); comprehensive agent found 'Best Western Plus Dayton South' (code 25028). Both retained as IDENTITY_PROVISIONAL. CODE CONFLICT: HIE Dayton North-Vandalia — first agent DAYVH, comprehensive agent DAYLY. CODE CONFLICT: BW Dayton NW — first agent 36145, comprehensive agent 34058. NAMESPACE NOTE: DAYBC used by Marriott (Courtyard Beavercreek) and IHG (HIE Beavercreek) — different systems, no collision. open_conflicts.description: 8099 Old Yankee St, Dayton 45458 claimed by two agents as different properties: first agent found The Hotel at Dayton South (independent); comprehensive agent found Best Western Plus Dayton South (code 25028). Same address, different names.

open_conflicts.description: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Dayton North-Vandalia: first agent reported property code DAYVH, comprehensive agent reported DAYLY. Census uses DAYLY.

The official IHG URL for this property is ihg.com/holidayinnexpress/hotels/us/en/dayton/dayly/hoteldetail — DAYLY appears as the property code path segment in the IHG URL, which is the authoritative brand-system identifier. The alternate code DAYVH (from first research agent) is rejected. Census entry retains DAYLY. Identity state upgraded from IDENTITY_PROVISIONAL to IDENTITY_CONFIRMED (URL evidence resolves the code conflict; address and phone are on record).
